reviews.author: Purelife Purelife
reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of working with Mr. C. Perry and Tyrin on a nursing legal matters, and I cannot emphasize enough how phenomenal his assistance has been. From our first consultation, Mr. Perry demonstrated a deep understanding of the complexities involved in healthcare law, particularly as it pertains to nursing practices. His meticulous attention to detail and comprehensive knowledge of legal statutes ensured that I felt informed and confident throughout the entire process. Mr. Perry was always available to address my questions, providing clear and concise explanations that helped demystify the legal jargon. What truly sets Mr. Perry apart is his genuine dedication to his clients. He takes the time to understand individual cases thoroughly, which resulted in tailored advice and strategies that specifically catered to my needs. His professionalism, combined with a personable approach, made a potentially daunting situation much more manageable. Overall, my experience with Mr. C. Perry and Tyrin was outstanding. I wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone seeking expert assistance in nursing legal matters. His expertise and commitment to his clients are truly commendable.

reviews.author: Sam
reviews.text: I just want to say if you have any doubt in acquiring your license back or you are in jeopardy of losing it, don't hesitate call Craig Perry. He saved my career! I thought I had no chance of getting my nursing license back after spending 10 years in prison. He first convinced me he could do it then he showed me! It was amazing! I wish everyone who went through something similar in life could watch my journey from start to finish. He will remove all doubt. Him and his staff are top notch! If you don't believe I'm real, I will tell you in person, just set it up. Thanks Craig for everything.

reviews.author: Sandra D.
reviews.text: Craig Perry is a lifesaver. He accepted my call while out of the country in the middle of a hurricane. Talk about commitment to his clients! He is dedicated, attentive, compassionate, honest, and straightforward. He is extremely knowledgeable in nursing practice law and knows the ins and outs of the board of nursing. His support staff, especially Tyrin, is amazing. He is worth every penny. Don't hesitate to hire him. You won't regret it. He saved my license and my career. Thank you Craig for all you did for me.

reviews.author: Nurse in Nevada
reviews.text: Mr. Perry and Tyrin were truly a blessing to me in such a dark time. I had to defend my nursing license before the Board of Nursing and the Board of Pharmacy, and these two truly advocated for me and showcased their true expertise in handling these types of cases. Tyrin and Mr. Perry are exceptionally kind, knowledgable, and supportive, and I felt so supported throughout handling my case which took over 7 months to come to a close. Mr. Perry ensured that I received the fair outcome, and my case was closed. I cannot thank these two enough for their grace, advocacy, honesty, and kindness. Your representation DOES effect your outcome! I would recommend Mr. Perry and Tyrin to anyone needing an honest attorney who truly cares about their clients.

reviews.author: Akel Ahmad
reviews.text: Receiving a board complaint is scary and when I received a letter from the Nevada State Board of Nursing, I got really stressed out. I initially went through my malpractice insurance for representation and did not feel heard, I then reached out to Craig Perry because I heard good things from a fellow friend and nurse practitioner who used him in the past and highly recommended him. Craig accepted my case with in a few days notice, worked on my case after hours, and helped close the case within a week. I cannot recommend Craig enough. I will be using him again in the future if need be. I highly recommend Craig and his staff.

reviews.author: Annette Asbury
reviews.text: Where do I begin...I have so much gratitude and appreciation for attorney Perry and his paralegal, Tyrin, that words cannot express. I never thought, in my 38 years in the nursing profession, that I would ever need legal representation. However, everything changed 2 years ago when I became associated with some extremely unscrupulous people whose sole purpose was to ruin my career. I truly believe that they would have accomplished that if I hadn't found Mr. Perry and Tyrin. They explained everything to me, answered my questions in a very reasonable amount of time, sometimes within the same hour I asked, or I could call Tyrin during business hours, and she would get answers from attorney Perry within an hour or so after I called. I LOVE the fact that they support the nursing profession, whether bedside nurses or an advanced practice nurse like myself. I would HIGHLY recommend them to anyone in the healthcare profession, especially advanced practice nurses, as I have already done. Although I hope that I will never have to hire them again, I am so grateful that they were here when I needed someone on my side.

reviews.author: Consciente Mente
reviews.text: An outstanding attorney — with an exceptional team behind him. Truly grateful for their support. I had an exceptional experience with this law firm. They represented my husband in a very complex and stressful case, and the attorney's professionalism, depth of knowledge, and integrity were evident from the very beginning. He guided us through the entire process with clarity and unwavering commitment, which brought true peace of mind during a time when we felt completely overwhelmed. Tyrin and the rest of the team were equally remarkable — consistently kind, patient, and attentive. They communicated every step with honesty and respect, and their support made a tremendous difference throughout the entire process. One thing that truly stood out is how much they genuinely care about their clients. Their dedication, empathy, and careful attention to detail made us feel protected and understood. It's clear that strong, ethical representation can truly shape the outcome of a case, and we are deeply grateful for everything they accomplished for my husband. I wholeheartedly recommend this attorney and his team to anyone who needs a legal professional who is not only highly skilled, but also compassionate, honest, and sincerely invested in achieving the best possible result.

reviews.text: Craig was a great attorney! Excellent staff who always listen to your concerns and needs. He was always honest and upfront about everything, which is rare when dealing with most attorneys. Also, Tyrin is one of the best paralegals in town, and I truly mean that. Craig is super lucky to have her, which is why they both make such a great team! Highly recommend them to anyone!

reviews.author: Jay Jose
reviews.text: Thank you so much Mr craig for your assistance. You God send from above you help me thru this hard times with the state board of nursing. I can't do it without you thank you tyrin also for everything. Best lawyer in town

reviews.author: Kelli Nissen
reviews.text: I initially was overwhelmed and shocked at receiving a board complaint and set right to Google to find help. Mr. Perry’s name came up amongst others and I decided to reach out. I had spoken with two other attorneys who seemed eager to collect my payment in our 5 minute phone call. Mr. Perry was different. We spent over an hour on a Zoom conference where he listened, took notes and engaged in my concerns. He wanted to know the details but he also wanted to understand me and the way I practice. He was very thorough in his explanation and he knew my Nursing Board investigator by name as he works directly with this person multiple times in the week. I felt a huge weight lifted knowing that Mr. Perry genuinely cares about his clients and has the knowledge, experience and empathy to get the job done! I am so thankful for Mr. Perry and his team, including Tyrin, for all of their support during my case! I cannot recommend Craig K. Perry enough!

reviews.author: Kyara Bryant
reviews.text:
In a climate where nurses go through so much in our day-to-day careers and often feel unappreciated, having to face the Board of Nursing can be absolutely earth-shattering. In moments like that, you want someone with experience, wit, respect, and professionalism in your corner.

Craig Perry not only heard me and truly understood what was at stake, but he also defended me fiercely and ultimately got my case closed without any detriment to my nursing license and/or career. I cannot thank him and his team enough for their dedication, guidance, and support from beginning to end.

10/10 would recommend. God bless you and your entire team.

reviews.author: Jason Mckinney
reviews.text:

I've recommended LV Nurse Attorney to many other colleagues and will continue to do so. Thank you Mr. Perry!

reviews.author: RN in NV
reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about Craig Perry and his assistant Tyrin. If any nurse has a complaint from the BON, they know how stressful it can be. I was so blessed to have found Mr Perry.  He is extremely experienced, knowledgeable, thorough and approachable. He always made time for me and my concerns as he legitimately cares about his clients and their outcome. Craig Perry fought for me, as he was always anticipating the BON’s next step. Ultimately, my case was completely closed with no discipline thanks to Craig and Tyrin. Just hire him! He is absolutely amazing and he’s worth every penny.

reviews.author: littletwinstar
reviews.text: My free initial consultation with attorney Craig Perry sealed the deal for me. I never felt rushed or timed. He spent an hour talking to me about my case with the BON. He communicated well and answered all my questions. Craig Perry was straightforward and was so easy to talk to. I really felt comfortable for him to represent me. His office manager Tyrin was so kind and respectful. In a very short span of time, my case got dismissed. If you have a complaint with the BON, please do not hesitate to call attorney Craig Perry.

reviews.author: Morgan Hart
reviews.text: Craig was recommended to me by a colleague when I unfortunately was in a position a nurse does not want to be in. I reviewed many lawyers and called Craig and am grateful that I did. Tryin was helpful in getting back to me quickly and setting up a video meeting with Craig. He told me from the initial meeting after hearing what I had to say, what his plan was his, what he expected, and provided me with similar cases to mine that he has handled. He gave me realistic expectations and what he would do if it didn’t work out in the way we wanted to. Craig gave me a realistic goal and delivered to me the news I was hoping for - I appreciate him as someone that will tell you what is realistic and what is not in terms of expectations. Thank you Craig and Tyrin for helping me defend my license. Tyrin put up with all my calls, questions, document uploads. Craig was personable, kind, and knowledgeable. I would recommend this team to any nurse concerned about a complaint against their license.

reviews.author: Brittany Cheng
reviews.text: I was referred to Craig by a colleague that helped him previously, and I just want to say a huge thank you to Craig & his team for helping me with my case! Dealing with the nursing board is a complex process and I'm so grateful that Craig & his team helped me navigate through the process. Without him I don't think my case would have been dismissed!! You won't regret hiring him!!

reviews.author: Kristy Burke
reviews.text: I found Craig Perry and Associates through a Google search, but I will forever be grateful for the service they provided. From the beginning, I felt like I had two experts in my corner, two people who would fight to their last breath. Tyrin, the office manager, is a superhuman who makes sure everything is in place at all times. CP, the dude with a law degree, makes sure you are in the best position to win. Never, in my protracted case with the board, did I feel concerned that my people were there for me. Not a caveat, but the thing I want to remind people is that CP is NOT A NURSE. You are going to have to help educate him and make sure that he is aware of the situation you were in during your practice. The restrictions and specific circumstances. DO NOT take that as an indication that he is unable to defend you. He will kill it for you but he has to understand where you’re coming from, every environment is unique. Stand up for yourself—if you’re not guilty don’t pretend to be and he will support you every step of the way. I can’t recommend them enough, honestly, and owe a lot to this incredible team.

reviews.author: Marcus H.
reviews.text:
When my life and career were turned upside down by serious allegations, the fear was overwhelming. From the very first conversation, Mr. Perry brought clarity and reassurance.
No matter how anxious I became, he was always available and reminded me to trust the process.
His words weren't empty promises, the outcome spoke for itself. Having the right attorney made all the difference. His expertise is unmatched. I wouldn't trust anyone else.

reviews.author: Day Mason
reviews.text: I was rear ended earlier this year, and I hired Craig K. Perry and Associates to handle my case. They made the process very stress-free, and were very helpful getting my settlement. I would've been absolutely lost without their help, and I was able to land on two feet a lot quicker thanks to this firm! Their team is very experienced and I'd absolutely recommend them if you need help after an accident.
